mapper.sql: email, analysis_date, status, requested_at, lease_expires_at, completed_at, liked_set_hash, valid_music_count, report_level, analysis_version, model, axis_stats::text AS axis_stats, findings::text AS findings, summary, narratives::text AS narratives, gms_response_id, failure_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM taste_analysis WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM taste_analysis WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'PENDING' AND lease_expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE taste_analysis SET status = 'FAILED', completed_at = #{requestedAt}, lease_expires_at = NULL, failure_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED' WHERE email = #{email} AND status = 'PENDING' AND lease_expires_at <= #{requestedAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO taste_analysis ( email, analysis_date, status, requested_at, lease_expires_at) VALUES ( #{email}, #{analysisDate}, 'PENDING', #{requestedAt}, #{leaseExpiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (email, analysis_date) DO UPDATE SET status = 'PENDING', requested_at = EXCLUDED.requested_at, lease_expires_at = EXCLUDED.lease_expires_at, completed_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL WHERE taste_analysis.status = 'FAILED' OR (taste_analysis.status = 'PENDING' AND taste_analysis.lease_expires_at <= EXCLUDED.requested_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE taste_analysis SET status = 'SUCCESS', completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_expires_at = NULL, liked_set_hash = #{likedSetHash}, valid_music_count = #{validMusicCount}, report_level = #{reportLevel}, analysis_version = #{analysisVersion}, model = #{model}, axis_stats = CAST(#{axisStats} AS jsonb), findings = CAST(#{findings} AS jsonb), summary = #{summary}, narratives = CAST(#{narratives} AS jsonb), gms_response_id = #{gmsResponseId}, failure_code = NULL WHERE email = #{email} AND analysis_date = #{analysisDate} AND status = 'PENDING' AND requested_at = #{requestedAt}
